title: Reef Guardian and Environmental Monitoring
summary: This community centers around Reef Guardian's response to a reported event – a music video shoot – and subsequent environmental assessment. Communication between Reef Guardian HQ and an assessment team highlights concerns about potential environmental impact and permit violations, with a focus on monitoring water contamination levels.
